name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 27 times in 11 visits over 36 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 54 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 36 hours starting 2026-05-02, at wavelengths from 0.83 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 3 moving objects.
